title: Comparison of tower purity with reconstructed-trace purity
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and finite coefficient fields inside a fixed algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. For each finite $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ write $R_{E,W}=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}=\lim_n(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n)_W$ for $W=X,Y$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], let $\mathbf1_{E,W}=R_{E,W}$, and put $T_E=\mathbf1_{E,X}(d)[2d]$ [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Work in the derived-complete constructible finite-Tor categories [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], with completed tensor and pullback [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Put $P_E=Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}$ and $G_E=Rf^!_{\mathcal O_E}$, with the specified constructible adjunction and counit $\epsilon_E$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Fix one compactification of $f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Use its canonical projection-formula isomorphisms [def-exchange-projection] and the canonical realization comparisons of [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization].

Let $\delta_E:H_{f,\mathcal O_E}\xrightarrow{\sim}G_E$ be the unique counit-preserving comparison of right adjoints [det-sp-unique-right-adjoint], where $H_{f,\mathcal O_E}$ has the realized tower adjunction of [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection]. For $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ define the actual integral tower map
$$\gamma^T_{E,K}=\delta_{E,K}\circ R\lim\bigl(\gamma_{f,\bullet}(\operatorname{red}_YK)\bigr):Lf_E^*K(d)[2d]\longrightarrow G_EK,$$
using the diagonal orientation and tensor transpose of [det-sp-tower-gamma] and the canonical source realization. Here the tower levels $\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$ and the uniformizer levels are identified by their canonical cofinal reduction/limit comparisons. Put $a^T_E=\gamma^T_{E,\mathbf1_{E,Y}}:T_E\xrightarrow{\sim}G_E\mathbf1_{E,Y}$.

Write $0$ for the coefficient field $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Choose any integral isomorphism $g_0:T_0\xrightarrow{\sim}G_0\mathbf1_{0,Y}$ whose finite reductions, under the specified reduction comparisons, are the unit-object purity maps of [thm-pur-adic-reconstruction, def-pur-smooth-purity-map]. Define $t_0=\epsilon_{0,\mathbf1}\circ P_0(g_0)$. For finite $E$, use ordinary derived change of completed coefficient sheaves $C_{E/0,W}=-\otimes^L_{R_{0,W}}R_{E,W}$ and the compact-support and twist comparisons of [det-sp-field-extension-towers]:
$$c_E:C_{E/0,Y}P_0\xrightarrow{\sim}P_EC_{E/0,X},\qquad \theta_E:C_{E/0,X}T_0\xrightarrow{\sim}T_E.$$
Set
$$t_E=C_{E/0,Y}(t_0)\circ c_{E,T_0}^{-1}\circ P_E(\theta_E^{-1}):P_ET_E\longrightarrow\mathbf1_{E,Y}.$$
Let $\Pi_{E,K}:P_E(Lf_E^*K\widehat\otimes^LT_E)\xrightarrow{\sim}K\widehat\otimes^LP_ET_E$ denote inverse projection with tensor symmetries. Define $\gamma^{\mathrm{tr}}_{E,K}$ to be the adjoint transpose, under the specified $P_E\dashv G_E$, of $(1_K\widehat\otimes t_E)\circ\Pi_{E,K}$, with the twist reassociation and unit constraints understood.

Then $g_0=a^T_0$, $t_E=\epsilon_{E,\mathbf1}\circ P_E(a^T_E)$, and
$$\gamma^{\mathrm{tr}}_{E,K}=\gamma^T_{E,K}$$
as integral derived morphisms, for every finite $E$ and every indicated $K$. In particular, if $Q_E$ is scalar localization [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], let $\gamma^{\mathrm{rat}}$ be the previously specified rational purity family of [thm-pur-rational-and-qbar-purity], whose integral representatives are the simultaneous integral family of [lem-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality] in its trace-transpose form, that is, the maps $\gamma^{\mathrm{tr}}_{E,K}$ above for some such $g_0$. Then $\gamma^{\mathrm{rat}}$ satisfies
$$\gamma^{\mathrm{rat}}_{f,Q_EK}=Q_E(\gamma^T_{E,K})$$
under the canonical source and counit-preserving target identifications. The coefficient comparisons in this equality are precisely those of [det-sp-field-extension-towers], and equality remains true for their common-stage images [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category].

source.place: Clause (1), rank-one uniqueness ('a map of rank-one tower sheaves is determined by its levels'), and clause (2), projection-and-counit transpose; compared with sk-lem-sp-field-extension/sk-lem-sp-field-extension-towers clauses (2)-(3) and sk-thm-purity-transport/thm-pur-rational-and-qbar-purity proof Steps 1-2
source.note: Agent comparison lemma required by the return C4/E5. The unit orientation is compared using its shifted rank-one source; the conclusion does not assert faithfulness of separate evaluations on general derived morphisms.
